doc_metadata.title: TC-04.5 — Equipment List
doc_metadata.caption: Navigate to Equipment. Equipment records track individual tools, vehicles, and machinery used in maintenance operations.

doc_metadata.title: TC-04.5 — Equipment List View
doc_metadata.caption: The Equipment list shows all registered equipment with IDs, descriptions, types (Owned/Rented), and status. Use filters and search to locate specific equipment.

doc_metadata.title: TC-04.5 — Open Equipment Record
doc_metadata.caption: Click on an existing equipment record to view its details, including type, description, and linked work orders.

doc_metadata.title: TC-04.5 — Wait for Page Load
doc_metadata.caption: Wait for all page components to finish loading and rendering.

doc_metadata.title: TC-04.5 — Equipment Detail
doc_metadata.caption: The equipment detail page shows the equipment ID, type (Owned or Rented), description, and association fields. Equipment can be linked to work orders for resource tracking.
